heading: Find reusable assets
description: Search named environments and packages. Dependencies stay inside the bundle; choose where to use the asset.
search.label: Asset name or tag
search.help: Each source searches the records you are authorized to see. External registries are not queried.
source.hubHelp: Hub access policy also includes your project’s layers.
source.packagesHelp: Private packages and version tags in the current project.
source.environmentsHelp: Published, sealed environments prepared for cloud use.
source.failed: Could not load {source}. Other sources remain independent.
identity: Select an authenticated project to find assets.
dependencies.incomplete: The dependency chain is incomplete. It cannot be run as a complete environment.
name: Name
packages.unregistered: This project has no registered package namespace. Public/shared bundles and cloud environments remain independent.
version.label: Version or tag
empty: No matching assets in this source. Change the search or check publication and access.
emptyPage: No accessible complete bundles on this page. Continue to the next page.
page: {count} on this page · not a complete inventory total
cloud.unsupported: Cloud launch is not available for this environment.
cloud.description: Create a VM in your current project from this exact published environment. The server rechecks access, capacity and the immutable revision.
cloud.denied: Current project write and asset-use permission are required.
cloud.hubPrerequisite: Cloud launch needs an operator-prepared cloud environment. Hub/package downloads alone are not a VM launch API; choose a compatible result under Cloud environments.
cloud.uncertain: Do not repeat an uncertain request. Check instance and operation status first.
cloud.ready: The operation reports the environment ready. Open the instance for current status.
cloud.pending: Accepted or still being verified. A request is not proof that the VM is ready.
cloud.name: Instance name
cloud.consent: This action allocates project resources and consumes quota. It does not change your workspace or grant additional permissions.
local.managed: Local use requires the same complete bundle to be registered in the Hub. This cloud profile is not silently treated as a downloadable Hub package.
local.oci: OCI-root execution requires Linux amd64 with KVM. Do not assume it runs on Apple Silicon or as a cloud-image VM.
local.help: Run these commands beside the downloaded archive in a Python environment with Palimpsest installed. The original SDK safely extracts and verifies the bundle, then resolves its base and dependencies automatically. Runtime and architecture checks still apply.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select and copy the commands manually.
local.cliHelp: Configure the original Palimpsest Hub or native registry profile and local credentials first. CLI transfer avoids loading large bundles into browser memory; browser download is limited to 64 MiB.
local.noReference: The native registry reference is not configured. Use the authorized browser download or ask the operator to configure the reference authority.
local.incompatible: This bundle lacks a compatible boot image or architecture metadata. Ask the operator for a complete runnable environment bundle.
cloud.cleanupConfirm: Clean up any VM, port, writable volume and read-only access grants retained by operation #{id}? Deleted resources cannot be restored.
local.unpackPrerequisite: These unpack/run steps require bundle unpack, added in the current working source. Do not assume the guide’s published 0.3.5 client includes it. After a matching client release or reviewed source installation, verify palimpsest bundle unpack --help succeeds.
local.unpackConfirmed: I verified that my installed client supports bundle unpack
